analysis:
Examined head docs/architecture/inference.md lines 1617-2394. Within these units, the only changed range is head 1740-1759. That range documents the native-tracked engine refusing token constraints and unsupported topLogprobs rows before reservation. Requests that would fail are refused as a 400 client_error, not a 500 generation_failure. This avoids striking the inference-error breaker, so consumer-triggered breaker trips are less likely (availability, ADV-002). The range also documents GLM5-Next logprob rows decoding target-only with exact output. This is documentation of provider-side admission and is consistent with T-008 and T-010 concerns. It introduces no new data exposure, encryption bypass or cache identity change, so T-041 is unaffected.

Other changed ranges are outside these units:
- Head 684-691 describes GLM5-Next weight-hash publication. Hashes are reused via VerifiedWeightHashStore on unchanged file metadata (device/inode/size/mtime/ctime) without re-reading weights at coordinator registration. This is relevant to T-012, T-027 and A-004. A local operator can preserve stat metadata while modifying content (e.g., via a raw device or by restoring times; ctime is harder to forge). The text says the load verifies again before serving. Integration should check that the registered hash cannot be advertised for routing before that re-verification completes. The weight hash is self-reported per A-004 anyway.
- Head 818-821 and 884-903 cover video frame timing (VFR tracks now accepted). Integration should confirm bounded frame counts.

No regression is supported by the units reviewed here.
